calls.title: Utkarsh Srivastava and Chris Sanders
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around a phased migration strategy for transitioning from a self-hosted GrowthBook instance to the cloud. Key points included exporting MongoDB collections with an automated script, ensuring that the self-hosted instance is locked during this process to prevent data loss. The proxy retention strategy allows flexibility in gradually updating SDK URLs while maintaining the existing API keys. Security measures were discussed regarding the management of JWT tokens and encryption keys in the cloud environment. Performance expectations highlighted no anticipated latency increase with the use of Fastly CDN and AWS infrastructure. Additionally, the meeting noted upcoming plans for analytics integration and the need for user seat adjustments, with specific next steps outlined for execution.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, cloud migration, proxy, MongoDB, SSO integration, CDN latency
